GET iFold MAC

Download.
Then one extra click.

iFold Mac is free and open source. It isn’t notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch takes one extra step — it’s spelled out below.

Download ifold-mac.dmg ↓

Version 1.2.0 · 1.2 MB · macOS Sonoma 14+ · Apple silicon MacBook with a lid sensor (M2 Air and later, 14-inch / 16-inch Pro)

iFold Mac is free, and stays that way. Sponsor the project and you fund the Apple Developer membership that makes the extra click below go away.

Installing

  1. Drag iFold Mac to Applications. Open the disk image, drag the app across, then launch it from Applications.
  2. When macOS says it “could not verify iFold Mac.app”, click Done. Not Move to Trash. This appears for every app that isn’t notarized, and Done is what unlocks the next step.
  3. Allow it once. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to the bottom, click Open Anyway, then Open. Or skip the dialog from Terminal: 
    xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/iFold Mac.app"
  4. Grant Screen Recording, then Relaunch. iFold Mac bends a live copy of your screen, so macOS asks for Screen Recording. Turn it on under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, then click Relaunch in iFold Mac.

Frames are processed on your Mac and stay in GPU memory. Nothing is recorded to disk or uploaded. Every release lists its SHA-256 on GitHub.

Rather build it yourself?

git clone https://github.com/maheshj01/ifold-mac.git && cd ifold-mac && ./build.sh --run

Needs Xcode. The app you get is identical — source on GitHub.
